guarantees.claim: cipher_op is driven to CIPH_INV only when (aes_mode_q==AES_ECB && aes_op_q==AES_DEC) or (aes_mode_q==AES_CBC && aes_op_q==AES_DEC); for all other modes (CFB, OFB, CTR) and the default fallback, cipher_op is driven to CIPH_FWD.
aes_ctr instance u_aes_ctr is connected: clk_i, rst_ni, incr_i from ctr_incr, ready_o to ctr_ready, alert_o to ctr_alert, ctr_i from iv_q, ctr_o to ctr, ctr_we_o to ctr_we.

assumptions.claim: aes_mode_q and aes_op_q only take the defined encoding values (AES_ECB, AES_CBC, etc.) and are stable during normal operation.
assumptions.risk: if mode/op are invalid or glitch, cipher_op may temporarily select the wrong direction (though default CIPH_FWD limits impact).

assumptions.claim: ctr_incr is only asserted and holds a valid increment value when the AES engine is in CTR mode and a new keystream block is required; it is de-asserted in other modes and during idle.
assumptions.risk: spurious assertion of ctr_incr outside CTR mode would incorrectly advance the counter, compromising keystream uniqueness and possibly causing denial of service.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment 'This primitive is used to place a size-only constraint on the buffers to act as a synthesis optimization barrier' (lines 413-414) does not correspond to any visible primitive or buffer in this region; it may be a leftover or refer to a removed/logically adjacent construct.
uncertain_points.risk: could indicate missing synthesis constraints or an incomplete understanding of buffer requirements.

uncertain_points.claim: ctr_alert from u_aes_ctr is connected but its internal trigger condition is unknown; if it indicates a critical fault (e.g., counter overflow, invalid state), the system must react appropriately, and mishandling could be a security gap.
uncertain_points.risk: unhandled alert may allow cryptographic faults to propagate undetected.

uncertain_points.claim: ctr_we is output from u_aes_ctr but its usage outside this region is not shown; if improperly gated or interpreted, it could cause unintended counter updates or overwrite iv_q.
uncertain_points.risk: erroneous counter write could break CTR keystream and data confidentiality.
